parsed_json.up: Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifiers and canonical SMILES for compounds tested against human histone deacetylase 6. Join molecule_dictionary to activities, then assays, then target_dictionary to match the target. Join compound_structures as an INNER JOIN to require SMILES. Alias the molecule identifier as molecule_chembl_id. Return molecule_chembl_id and canonical_smiles. Sort by molecule_chembl_id.
